a kind of garment

a kind of garment, about which Pollux 7, 60: "the mandyē is somewhat similar to the so-called phainolē. Whose garment it is, so that we do not go around asking about Cretans or Persians, Aeschylus will say: 'a tunic in imitation of a Liburnian mandyē.'" Stephanus of Byzantium, s.v. Λιβυρνοί p. 415, 10: "Liburnian ships and a Liburnian mandyē, a kind of clothing, are found." He mentions the Persians because the mandyē, or the more common form mandyas, is a kind of Persian garment, about which see the grammarians cited in the Thesaurus vol. 5 p. 562.
